items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Harry Klee? ... [INTERVIEWEE] It could have been a sax solo by Harry Klee and maybe that part got left out.

ctx.x: When you first ran into Raeburn, at that point Eddie was writing for the band, the first phase, and who else; do you remember who had contributed some stuff? Harry Klee wrote some things, it seems to me.
